say:2:1241109001:1.text: Hey, little hamster knight, are you alright? Why do you look like you're about to pass out?
say:2:1241109001:1.source_cn: 嘿，仓鼠小骑士，你还好吧？怎么一脸马上要昏过去的样子？

say:4:1241109003:1.text: There's water all around... the sea, lakes, rivers, and creeks...
say:4:1241109003:1.source_cn: 到处都是水……大海，湖泊，河流，小溪……

say:5:1241109004:1.text: Whenever Chippy sees water now, he remembers drowning...
say:5:1241109004:1.source_cn: 满满现在一看到水，就会回想起溺水后那种快要窒息的感觉……

choice_prompt:6:1241109004.text: Whenever Chippy sees water now, he remembers drowning...
choice_prompt:6:1241109004.source_cn: 满满现在一看到水，就会回想起溺水后那种快要窒息的感觉……

say:7:1241109005:1.text: Magister, you forgot again! When we first abandoned the ship, we swam together to the island! Chippy knows how to swim!
say:7:1241109005:1.source_cn: 主人你又忘了！最开始弃船的时候，我们一起游到了小岛上！...
say:7:1241109005:1.male: Magister, you forgot again! When we first abandoned the ship, we swam together to the island! Chippy knows how to swim!
say:7:1241109005:1.female: Magister, you forgot again! When we first abandoned the ship, we swam together to the island! Chippy knows how to swim!

say:8:1241109006:1.text: Then why were you sputtering so much earlier?
say:8:1241109006:1.source_cn: 那你之前还被呛得够呛？

say:9:1241109007:1.source_cn: ……那是因为这身骑士盔甲太沉了！

say:10:1241109008:1.text: And so is this sword! Chippy had to train for ages just to be able to lift it!
say:10:1241109008:1.source_cn: 还有这把沉甸甸的骑士剑！满满为了拿起它，可是拼命锻炼了...

choice_prompt:11:1241109008.text: And so is this sword! Chippy had to train for ages just to be able to lift it!
choice_prompt:11:1241109008.source_cn: 还有这把沉甸甸的骑士剑！满满为了拿起它，可是拼命锻炼了很久呢！

say:12:1241109009:1.text: That's right. Your life is worth more than any material goods. It's just armor and a sword...
say:12:1241109009:1.source_cn: 这话说的没错。和自己的小命比起来，再昂贵的东西也会变得...

say:13:1241109010:1.text: I'm no expert, but even I can see they aren't even that valuable. They're all dented and worn—
say:13:1241109010:1.source_cn: 虽然我在这方面见识不多，但一眼就能看出来，你这两样东西...

say:14:1241109011:1.text: —Bit your tongue! How can you measure their worth based on price alone?
say:14:1241109011:1.source_cn: ——你！你怎么能单纯用金钱来衡量它们的价值？！

say:15:1241109012:1.text: A knight's armor and sword are symbols of his honor! How could I just cast them into the sea?!
say:15:1241109012:1.source_cn: 对于一名骑士来说，盔甲和剑就是荣誉的象征，怎么能轻易放...

say:16:1241109013:1.text: What's more, I crafted them specifically to help me protect my Magister! These are treasures you can't buy just anywhere!
say:16:1241109013:1.source_cn: 而且它们还是我为保护主人而量身打造的，是独一无二的宝物...
say:16:1241109013:1.male: What's more, I crafted them specifically to help me protect my Magister! These are treasures you can't buy just anywhere!
say:16:1241109013:1.female: What's more, I crafted them specifically to help me protect my Magister! These are treasures you can't buy just anywhere!

say:17:1241109014:1.text: If Chippy really lost them... Chippy couldn't show his face as the Magister's familiar!
say:17:1241109014:1.source_cn: 要是真的搞丢了它们……满满也没脸再当主人的使魔了！
say:17:1241109014:1.male: If Chippy really lost them... Chippy couldn't show his face as the Magister's familiar!
say:17:1241109014:1.female: If Chippy really lost them... Chippy couldn't show his face as the Magister's familiar!

say:18:1241109015:1.text: …Alright, alright, you really are a stubborn—I mean, a truly stoic, competent knight.
say:18:1241109015:1.source_cn: ……好吧好吧，你还真是个死脑——啊不，你真是一位称职的骑士。

say:19:1241109016:1.text: May the god of the waves protect you... and keep you from drowning again.
say:19:1241109016:1.source_cn: 但愿风浪与漂泊之神保佑你，别让你再掉进水里。

say:20:1241109017:1.text: Chippy won't be caught off guard again! Drowning is not an option!
say:20:1241109017:1.source_cn: 满满已经在克服了，溺水这种事……绝对不会发生第二次！

choice:6:1:2.text: Time to teach you how to swim.
choice:6:1:2.male: Time to teach you how to swim.
choice:6:1:2.female: Time to teach you how to swim.
